name: Broadside
summary: A letterpress broadside: newsprint stock, everything centered, a slab display face with a book serif, thick-thin rules and fleurons, one red second color.
lineage: 19th-century American letterpress broadsides, handbills and auction notices set in wood and metal type.

motion.grammar: press: a short, firm impression; elements settle from 104% scale in .3 s

frame: thick-thin double rules across the top and bottom; project and page centered under them
